places.name: Specksgang 24, Hamburg
places.country: Free City of Hamburg (German Confederation; today Germany)
places.what: Born in a small flat and baptised at St Michaelis; studied with Cossel, then Marxsen from 1845.

places.name: Hanover
places.what: On tour with Reményi, he visited Joseph Joachim, beginning a lifelong friendship.

places.name: Düsseldorf
places.country: Kingdom of Prussia (Rhine Province; today Germany)
places.what: Welcomed by the Schumanns with Joachim’s letter; after Robert’s collapse he supported Clara’s household.

places.name: Detmold court
places.what: Court musician in the winters, leading a choir and teaching; he wrote two Serenades there.

places.name: Hanover
places.what: Premiere of the First Piano Concerto with the composer as soloist; the audience received it coldly.

places.name: Vienna
places.what: First visit, staying over the winter; Hanslick reviewed his Vienna debut; he led the Singakademie 1863–64.

places.name: Bremen
places.country: Free Hanseatic City of Bremen (today Germany)
places.what: First complete performance of A German Requiem, to great acclaim; a seventh movement was added for Leipzig in 1869.

places.name: Karlsgasse 4, Vienna
places.what: His rented flat in Wieden, where he lived for the rest of his life and died.

places.name: Karlsruhe
places.what: The First Symphony, begun in 1855, premiered under his friend Felix Otto Dessoff.

places.name: Pörtschach am Wörthersee
places.country: Duchy of Carinthia (Austrian Empire; today Austria)
places.what: Composed the Second Symphony in the summer; the Vienna Philharmonic premiered it under Richter on 30 December.

places.name: Gewandhaus, Leipzig
places.what: Joachim premiered the Violin Concerto here, dedicated to him, opening the concert with Beethoven’s concerto.

places.name: Budapest
places.what: Public premiere of the Second Piano Concerto, with Brahms as soloist; an immediate success.

places.name: Bad Ischl
places.what: First visited in 1882; from 1889 he spent every summer in his house here, writing late chamber music.

places.name: Wiesbaden
places.what: Composed the Third Symphony during a summer stay; the Vienna Philharmonic premiered it under Richter on 2 December.

places.name: Mürzzuschlag
places.what: Composed the Fourth Symphony during the summers of 1884 and 1885.

places.name: Meiningen court
places.what: Conducted the Meiningen Court Orchestra in the premiere of the Fourth Symphony.

places.name: Thun
places.what: Spent three summers here, visiting the Widmann family in Bern at weekends.

places.name: Vienna
places.what: His last public appearance: he watched Hans Richter conduct his Fourth Symphony, with applause after every movement.

places.name: Karlsgasse 4, Vienna
places.what: Died early in the morning, aged sixty-three, of liver or pancreatic cancer; funeral on 6 April at the Lutheran Stadtkirche.

places.name: Zentralfriedhof, Vienna
places.what: Buried in an honorary grave, Group 32A, No. 26; the Conrat monument was unveiled on 7 May 1903.
